application_fee.details: For offline mode, applicants must pay through a Demand Draft or Banker's Cheque drawn in favour of State Project Director, Jharkhand Education Project Council, Ranchi. For online mode, payment is made through Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking, or UPI via the JEPC website post submission of the application form.

age_limit.details: The maximum age limit for applying for the position of School Manager is 62 years as on 1.10.2026. The maximum age of a selected candidate for renewal of the contract on an annual basis shall be 65 years.

qualification.education_qualification: Retired Principals/Vice Principals of CBSE/ICSE/Navodaya/Kendriya Vidyalaya OR Post Graduate Teachers (PGT) with 20 years teaching and administrative experience
qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | manager, school of excellence: 1. Retired Principals/Vice Principals of CBSE, ICSE, Navodaya Vidyalaya, or Kendriya Vidyalaya. OR 2. Post Graduate Teachers (PGT) of CBSE, ICSE, Navodaya Vidyalaya, Kendriya Vidyalaya, or Army School having 20 years of teaching experience along with Administrative Experience (Academic In charge, Examination In charge, Time-Table In charge, Class Representative, Co-ordinator, etc.). Preference shall be given to more experienced candidates and candidates having substantial experience as Principal or Vice-Principal in CBSE-affiliated schools.

selection_process: Selection shall be made either through an interview or through a written test followed by an interview
depending on the number of applicants for the respective post
as determined by the JEPC Selection Committee headed by the State Project Director.
how_to_apply: Visit the official website https://jepc.jharkhand.gov.in and navigate to the recruitment link on the notice board menu to download the application form.
Fill in all entries in capital letters.
Enclose attested copies of testimonials, experience certificates, age proof, and other essential documents with the application form.
For offline mode, attach a non-refundable demand draft or banker's cheque of Rs. 1000/- in favour of State Project Director, Jharkhand Education Project Council, Ranchi.
For online mode, pay the application fee of Rs. 1000/- through Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking, or UPI on the website after submitting the form.

Send the completed application by registered post addressed to The State Project Director, Jharkhand Education Project Council, JSCA Stadium Road, Sector-3, Dhurwa, Ranchi 834004 or submit online by 21/10/2026 at 05:00 PM.
important_instructions: The selected candidates shall initially be appointed on a short-term contract for a period of one year. The contract may be extended on an annual basis, subject to satisfactory performance assessed through the Annual Performance Appraisal. Candidates belonging to SC, ST, EBC, BC, and EWS categories of Jharkhand must provide caste and reservation-related certificates as per Annexure-C. Preference will be given to candidates with substantial experience as Principal or Vice-Principal in CBSE-affiliated schools. Application received after the stipulated date (21/10/2026 by 05:00 PM) will not be accepted under any circumstances. One form should be used for one post, and all entries must be made in capital letters. Any dispute with regard to this recruitment will be subject to the court having its jurisdiction at Ranchi only.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Manager post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 56 vacancies available for the Manager for School of Excellence post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for JEPC Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications is 21 October 2026 by 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for JEPC Manager?
faq.answer: Candidates must be retired Principals/Vice Principals of CBSE, ICSE, Navodaya, or Kendriya Vidyalaya, OR Post Graduate Teachers (PGT) from these schools with 20 years of teaching and administrative experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 62 years as on 1 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for JEPC Manager Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1000/- for all categories, payable via Demand Draft/Banker's Cheque for offline mode or online payment gateways for online mode.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered to the School Manager?
faq.answer: The monthly honorarium is fixed at Rs. 60,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this post?
faq.answer: Selection is made through an interview or a written test followed by an interview, determined by the JEPC Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q8. Is the appointment permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a short-term contract basis for one year, extendable annually based on satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the offline application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications sent via registered post should be addressed to The State Project Director, Jharkhand Education Project Council, JSCA Stadium Road, Sector-3, Dhurwa, Ranchi 834004.
